decisions.reason: The connector-availability policy does not change any ESP32 sleep, clock, deep-sleep, or wake behavior.
The source concerns the USB connector under discussion, not the battery connector or its required NTC contact.
Requiring compatible alternatives for the selected USB connector does not change the native USB data-line behavior; sourceability remains owned by the source Requirement.
The component-availability policy does not alter the established three-board architecture.
The source does not change the switched 5V rail's converter, control, default state, purpose, or operating pattern.
The USB connector sourceability decision does not affect I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
